name: MIAA Cross Country Championships
headline: MIAA Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Washburn won the men’s title with 48 points, three ahead of Pittsburg State (51), and Missouri Southern won the women’s with 60 over Rogers State (69) and Pittsburg State (72). Pittsburg State’s Dylan Sprecker (24:19.1) and Missouri Southern’s Ruth Chemutai (20:32.0) won the individual races.
